obfuscation_indicators: may continue to be adversely affected
risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified but uses extensive legal boilerplate and recurring forward-looking caveats. Key risks include sustained operating and net losses, low gross margins, significant customer concentration, demand volatility, technology-sector exposure, and lack of committed purchasing obligations. Adjusted EBITDA exclusions and repeated non-GAAP framing may make underlying performance harder to assess.
